item.text: The existing inline renderer already has a placeholder mechanism for escaped punctuation, but it decodes all entities before recognizing code spans, which violates the required context restriction. I’m changing decoding to occur only in ordinary inline text and handling numeric validity explicitly; code blocks/spans and raw HTML remain literal.
